trace.question: Among the posts with a score of over 5, what is the percentage of them being owned by an elder user?
trace.evidence: score of over 5 refers to Score > 5; elder user refers to Age > 65; percentage = Divide (Count(Id where Age>65), Count(Id)) * 100

attempts.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5

trace.final_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5
trace.answer: About 16.57% of posts with a score above 5 are owned by an elder user.
